---
name: Recipe proposal
about: Propose a new example, tutorial or integration before you build it
title: "[recipe] <working title>"
labels: recipe-proposal
---

**What will it do?**
One paragraph. Who is it for, and which problem does it solve?

**Bodhan models it will use**
- [ ] indic-transcribe (speech to text)
- [ ] indic-translate (translation)
- [ ] indic-transliterate (transliteration)
- [ ] indic-speak (text to speech)
- [ ] indic-ocr (document OCR)

**Other services or frameworks**
e.g. a companion LLM, FastAPI, Next.js, LiveKit, n8n.

**Languages it will demonstrate**
e.g. Hindi, Tamil, Bengali.

**Would you like to build it yourself?**
Yes / No — either is fine. If yes, a maintainer will confirm the scope so you don't duplicate work in progress.
